headline: Asian markets fall on AI trade fears while Indian shares navigate crude oil pressure and recent volatility

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Doubts over AI trades triggered a tech rout in Asian markets, sending Kospi down 5% and Nikkei down 2.5%
Brent crude prices reached around $91 following a 2% rally amid supply risks from Hormuz attacks
Profit-taking dragged financials, banking, and metal stocks down following a four-week rally
US indices including Nasdaq and S&P 500 closed lower as investors evaluated Nvidia leadership developments
whatHappening: The Indian stock market previously suffered sharp losses with Sensex falling 1,484 points, bringing Nifty below 25,350
Investors lost over Rs 5 to 6 lakh crore in recent sell-offs, following a ₹34.61 trillion gain earlier in November
Indian share markets were shut on Tuesday, November 24, for Guru Nanak Jayanti
Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs recently driven by record foreign institutional investor (FII) buying
summary: Indian stock markets are trading today following a market holiday for Guru Nanak Jayanti. Asian markets face sharp declines due to AI trade concerns while Brent crude stays near $91 amid Hormuz supply risks. Domestically, markets have seen volatile movements after profit-taking in banking and metal stocks snapped a multi-week rally.
